notes: Opening SystemCare no longer asks for administrator rights every time. The window that asks about a newly installed program now waits until the installation has finished, so Keep and Remove both work, and it can be turned off in Settings. AdwCleaner is refreshed when the copy on the computer is out of date. The Network page has one button for clearing the DNS cache, the address cache and the system proxy together. Blocking extensions that are not in the recording is now a choice on the Browsers page, off by default. The Applications page shows when the list of programs was recorded.
